findings.message: A UI branch this feature added is missing from docs/match-online-coverage.md and has no test. In apps/web/src/flowHud.ts showBanner (line 647), `if (timers.hide !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(timers.hide)` re-arms the banner's 7 s hide when a new reveal arrives. The banner's auto-hide after BANNER_MS isn't asserted anywhere either. fullMatch.spec.ts only checks that the banner is hidden before the first reveal and visible after it. The host gets final-route and final-sector a few ms apart, so deleting the clearTimeout would fail no test. Add a table row and a test (for example a DOM unit test with fake timers: a second banner inside 7 s stays up for its own 7 s).
findings.requirement: A branch with no failing test gets a new test
